does: Ticks the statuses of every status machine whose owner is out of turn-based combat, by time: calls esv::StatusMachine::Tick on each machine's own and external status lists with tick type 2.

evidence.says: loops the machines at +0x70, filters them, and calls 0x2F73A60 twice per machine with tick type 2 and the bool 0 then 1
a probe shows esv::StatusMachine::Tick called 11016 times in 15 s from eight sites inside it; out of combat HOLD_PERSON's RemoveConditions were evaluated in that time
